## MCP - Entity - Search

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/entity-search

**Description:** Recherche semantique multi-tenant dans Qdrant avec enrichissement MongoDB optionnel. Remplace MCP Qdrant - Search (RFC-049).

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["action", "query"],
  "properties": {
    "action": { "type": "string", "enum": ["search", "similar"], "description": "search=par query, similar=par entity_id" },
    "query": { "type": "string", "description": "Texte de recherche (pour action=search)" },
    "entity_id": { "type": "string", "description": "UUID pour recherche similaire (pour action=similar)" },
    "entity_type": { "type": "string", "description": "Filtrer par type d'entite" },
    "limit": { "type": "integer", "default": 10, "description": "Nombre de resultats max" },
    "enrich": { "type": "boolean", "default": false, "description": "Enrichir depuis MongoDB" },
    "fields": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "description": "Champs a recuperer depuis DB" },
    "filters": { "type": "object", "description": "Filtres additionnels Qdrant" },
    "user_id": { "type": "string" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string" },
    "qdrant_host": { "type": "string" },
    "qdrant_port": { "type": "integer" },
    "qdrant_collection": { "type": "string" },
    "api_key": { "type": "string", "description": "Qdrant API key (fallback)" },
    "openai_api_key": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

**Headers:**
- `X-Tenant-ID`: Tenant identifier (REQUIRED for multi-tenant isolation)

**Multi-tenant:** CRITICAL - Qdrant queries MUST filter by tenant_id.

**Returns:**
- `results`: Array avec score et payload
- `entity`: Donnees enrichies MongoDB (si enrich=true)
- `_trace`: Informations de tracabilite
